commentary: With the market gate reading WEAK and breadth depressed at 41, Stan Weinstein's stage discipline and William O'Neil's market-direction rules take absolute precedence. Persistent foreign institutional distribution—highlighted by a 13-session selling streak—and crude headwinds create hostile conditions for standard breakout follow-through. When the broader market pulls back, Jesse Livermore warned that the general tide will overpower individual merchandise. Under Mark Minervini's progressive exposure framework, capital preservation is paramount: exposure should be curtailed to defensive pilot positions or cash. Only high-relative-strength candidates showing Stage 2 alignment and confirmed CANSLIM earnings acceleration merit consideration, while decelerating earnings must be downgraded to watch status and stopped out ruthlessly on pattern breakdown.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM, Weinstein Stage Analysis & Darvas Box Theory

63MOONS.technical: Consolidating above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 while shaping a double-bottom structure below the 958.91 pivot. Volume expansion of 3.63x demonstrates institutional accumulation, and RSI at 62 confirms constructive momentum without overbought extension.
63MOONS.fundamental: Triple-digit top-line expansion (+350% YoY consolidated) is overshadowed by severe bottom-line volatility, with Q1 FY27 slipping into a consolidated net loss of ₹47.6 crore. Negative operating margins and inconsistent ROCE fail CANSLIM quality hurdles.
63MOONS.risk: Thesis fails if price slips below the 874.42 base support. Exit immediately if the 200-day SMA is breached.

ABDL.technical: Trading above key EMAs in a post-IPO base, building a double-bottom handle toward the 754.55 trigger. Volume is modest at 1.29x average with RSI at 66, but relative strength remains subdued compared to industry leaders.
ABDL.fundamental: Top-line growth remains sluggish at +5.3% YoY with operating margins compressed at ~13.8%. Modest ROCE (~18%) and past debt overhang fail O'Neil's strict C+A earnings acceleration thresholds.
ABDL.risk: Breach below 689.11 invalidates base integrity. Enforce strict Minervini risk discipline upon any breakdown below moving average support.

ADVANCE.technical: Displaying textbook Stage 2 momentum, breaking to fresh 20-session highs at 141.64 on explosive volume (41.44x 20-day average). Moving averages (EMA21, SMA50, SMA200) are sequentially aligned with MACD expanding above the zero line.
ADVANCE.fundamental: Exceptional CANSLIM metrics: Q1 FY27 revenue doubled (+96% YoY to ₹330 Cr) alongside 153% PAT surge to ₹23 Cr. High ROCE (19.6%) and healthy balance sheet provide institutional fuel.
ADVANCE.risk: Break below the 125.05 support pivot invalidates the breakout. Cut losses rapidly if high-volume selling reverses the advance.

AEROENTER.technical: Exhibiting an advancing Stage 2 structure, coiling below the 159.76 pivot. Inside-range price contraction reflects classic VCP characteristics above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200, supported by balanced RSI momentum (61).
AEROENTER.fundamental: Headline earnings show rapid acceleration with revenue up 135% YoY to ₹333 Cr and PAT up 617%. However, extensive reliance on non-operating other income (₹144 Cr) warrants scrutiny over core operational earnings durability.
AEROENTER.risk: Thesis invalidates below 146.32. Exit promptly if core operating cash flows deteriorate or price loses intermediate moving averages.

ALLDIGI.technical: Strong 20-session breakout clearing 894.79 on outstanding 10.53x volume. The price structure shows healthy accumulation above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with MACD firmly above zero, indicating institutional accumulation.
ALLDIGI.fundamental: High financial quality with zero net debt, 29.7% ROCE, and 33.5% ROE. However, latest revenue growth slowed to +4.4% YoY and quarterly EPS decelerated to +21.7%, missing CANSLIM's 25%/15% dual-acceleration threshold.
ALLDIGI.risk: Failure to hold 848.00 negates the breakout pivot. Implement fast stop-loss execution if the stock falls back into its base.

ANGELONE.technical: Consolidating tightly within 1.5% of its 330.13 pivot on above-average 1.4x volume and RSI 58. The stock respects the Minervini Trend Template, sustaining strength above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 despite broader market weakness.
ANGELONE.fundamental: Pristine CANSLIM fundamentals: Q1 FY27 net profit surged 102% YoY to ₹231 Cr on 25.4% revenue expansion. Industry-leading ROE (>30%), expanding digital distribution, and robust operating leverage reinforce leadership status.
ANGELONE.risk: Stop loss triggered on breach below 310.37. Exit immediately if volume dries up on breakout attempts or market headwinds intensify.
